newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's may upgrade Mitsui Petchem, Mitsui Toatsu.
newsitem.headline: Moody's may upgrade Mitsui Petchem, Mitsui Toatsu.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it had placed its ratings of Mitsui Petrochemical Industries Ltd, Mitsui Toatsu Chemicals Inc and their units under review for a possible upgrade after news that the firms were considering a merger.
Moody's said the firms currently have senior debt ratings of Baa3.

"The review will focus on the pro-forma financial structure of any merged entity, the degree of any cost-cutting measures following such a merger and how much synergy will be created by the merger," Moody's said in a statement.
Moody's said it would also study the merged entity's ability to develop economies of scale, and the competitiveness of the new company.
